description: Role evals for the archival pack: the DECISIONS, scored. The adapter self-test asks whether a bad dossier is refused; nothing asked whether the Explorer read a collapse correctly, whether the Generator's producer derives the roots rather than accepting them, or whether the Researcher's shared-error analysis groups on error and not on agreement. A role eval is writable exactly where the judgement has machinery under it, so this is also the map of which judgements do.

explorer.why: four agreeing sources copying one register are one voice; reading the count off the bibliography is the field's characteristic error
a register and an independent letter are two, and refusing them would teach people the audit is noise
a chain of five copies is still one observation; length is not corroboration

generator.why: supporting_sources is a consequence of the graph, never a list the author chose
two sources each citing the other have no root, and a graph that cannot be walked cannot be collapsed
a derivation pointing at nothing breaks the one operation this pack performs

researcher.why: two witnesses sharing two errors are one voice, whatever the dossier declares
THE discriminating case: correct readings are most of every text, and a similarity measure gets this backwards
an unchecked declaration is not a finding of independence
many opportunities at a decent survival rate: the silence is evidence
the archive is silent about plenty of things that happened
a conclusion that needs the favourable end of a guessed rate is a conclusion about the guess
